name: AdGuard Home
description: DNS server with ad blocking, parental controls and encrypted DNS.
notes: Finish setup at port 3000, and set the web interface port to 3000 there as well (80 is used by Web Station).
compose:
services:
  adguardhome:
    image: adguard/adguardhome:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      - "3000:3000/tcp"
    volumes:
      - ./work:/opt/adguardhome/work
      - ./conf:/opt/adguardhome/conf
